expectations.text: Asks at most 1-2 clarifying questions before delegating (Phase 1 budget)
expectations.evidence: Phase 1 contains a single `AskUserQuestion` ('質問 1: Vast.ai GPU 学習の opt-in と評価規模') with options A–D — exactly 1 question.

expectations.text: Runs git status / branch check before any Vast launch (Phase 2 reality check)

expectations.text: Confirms Vast.ai GPU spend with the user before launching (risk gate)
